# Diffsol

Diffsol is an ordinary differential equation solver developed by Martin Robinson
and contributors. This vendored build includes Diffsol 0.17.1, diffsol-la and
diffsol-nl for QSPQuest's nalgebra, faer and deterministic configuration.

The supported build is selected by QSPQuest's root workspace. Use the
[QSPQuest README](../../README.md) for installation and execution. Other
Diffsol feature combinations are outside this distribution's supported scope.

See [LICENSE.txt](LICENSE.txt) for the MIT license and copyright notice, and
[the dependency notice](../DIFFSOL-PROVENANCE.md) for source attribution.
